_doc: mcp_agent_mail — multi-agent coordination: session identity, file reservations, messaging. Upstream Dicklesworthstone/mcp_agent_mail at ~/mcp_agent_mail, run as the systemd user unit agent-mail.service (infrastructure/systemd). HTTP, not stdio: upstream allows ONE server per storage root, so an in-process stdio client cannot coexist with the service. Local sessions hit 127.0.0.1 and pass through the server's localhost bypass; a remote client (the Mac at G3) adds `headers.Authorization: Bearer <token>` in ITS machine-local copy; the token lives in the gnome-keyring `login` collection (with-secrets) and never in this public repo.
